text:
Anya: Quick pass on the rules editor UX. Ran into a case where two rules end up with the same priority after bulk import and the list just stacks them with no hint. Thinking: introduce a small inline 'Conflict' chip with count + Resolve action that opens a lightweight, keyboard-first modal. Kai: Inline chip sounds good. If it's keyboard-first we should ensure Enter opens and Esc closes. Also the chip should be in the tab order. Josie: Accessibility: chip needs role=button and aria-expanded when the modal is open. When a conflict appears programmatically, announce via aria-live region: e.g., `Priority conflict detected between "Shipping - Free" and "Shipping - Expedited".` Ravi: On the sim side, important that resolving in the modal only re-runs the sandbox for the affected route, not the whole project. We can diff the route and run incremental sim. Lexi: Copy ideas: chip label "Conflict (2)"; modal title "Resolve priority conflict"; primary actions Promote / Demote; secondary action Merge (with tooltip: "Merge combines selectors; texts concatenated"). Anya: UX detail: avoid modal overkill. Make it light-dismissable, trap focus while open, but return focus to the chip when closed. Modal should show a compact side-by-side of rule conditions and a simple preview of expected match order. Kai: We should also add a toast when conflicts are auto-detected on import. Toast text: "Priority conflict found in Route: Checkout. Click to review." Clicking focuses the top conflict chip. Toast should land in the toast tray so keyboard users can find it. Josie: For group conflicts (A vs B and B vs C), suggest grouping by rule: show chips on the affected rules and allow modal nav to cycle through related conflicts rather than a giant list. Also ensure pluralization in screen reader copy: "1 conflict" vs "2 conflicts". ux-bot: Uploaded quick mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/1712349999-resolve-chip.png — shows chip states, modal with diff, and sim incremental badge. :white_check_mark: Ravi: Dev notes: add endpoint PATCH /routes/:id/resolve-conflict {action: "promote|demote|merge", target_priority: N}. Return route delta so sim can apply incremental changes. Tests: focus flow, keyboard shortcuts, and incremental sim trigger. Josie: I'll add the aria-live snippet to the accessibility checklist: ```
Priority conflict detected between "A" and "B"
``` Also link aria-describedby from chip to a short summary within the rule card. Lexi: UX microcopy: make Merge explicit in the tooltip: "Merge: combines selectors and joins rule bodies with a newline. Use when both rules should match the same traffic." Confirmation required for Merge. Anya: Next steps: Josie will add the a11y copy + snippets. Ravi will draft the incremental sim API. Kai and I will prototype the chip/modal flows and bring to next UX review. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
